lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Centroids in the mid-lateral section exhibit a semi-regular spacing forming a grid-like pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, acting as anchor nodes for the vertical structural grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge to a localized shadow gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular indentation/notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating tissue truncation.
